sample_unit: eye-level cases (from 149 patients) read by six ophthalmologists
models_evaluated: RETFound-based multimodal classifier (fundus photographs, OCT, 24 structured OCT/RNFL variables)

links.outcome: Ophthalmologist diagnostic performance with versus without AI assistance in paired sequential reading
links.effect: Model AUC 0.911; mean sensitivity 68.0% unaided vs 75.3% AI-assisted, accuracy 74.2% vs 79.6%, specificity 91.3% in both phases; reader-level differences not significant after multiplicity adjustment.
links.quote: Reader-level diagnostic differences were not significant after multiplicity adjustment and were exploratory.

screen.reason: Evaluates the impact of providing multimodal foundation-model AI assistance to ophthalmologists in a paired reader study comparing unaided versus AI-assisted diagnostic performance.
